verdict.rationale: Raygun has an official MCP server (MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun), which gives agents a path to its error data. The data includes full stack traces, prioritization by users affected and occurrences, and an error-status triage workflow. However, the evidence never shows what the MCP server exposes or that an agent can file bugs into an issue tracker; the only integrations shown are repo links, PagerDuty, and chat alerts, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented MCP or API tools for listing top issues with stack traces, documented issue-tracker (e.g. Jira or GitHub Issues) bug filing, programmatic status changes for triage, and hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
